The bagel has a golden-brown crust and is heavily topped with a mixture of seeds, appearing to be an 'everything' style blend (sesame, poppy, dried garlic/onion). The central hole is visible but partially obscured by the thick layer of toppings and the angle of the shot. The lighting creates specular highlights on the oily/shiny surface of the crust.
